m01:room.title: The Wheel Timing Shop
m01:room.job: Find out whether three stop slips are three facts or one.

m02:room.title: The Ship Load Room
m02:room.job: Work out what the Narwhal's arm supplies at the bottom of the swing.

m03:room.title: The Carousel Drive House
m03:room.job: Find the circle a hanging chair really rides, and the speed its lean allows.

m04:room.title: The Impact Test Bay
m04:room.job: Find what the floor took out of a loaded bumper car, and what the harness did to the dummy.

m05:room.title: The Brennan Metrology Room
m05:room.job: Decide whether speeds measured with an uncalibrated wheel can stand.

m06:room.title: The Independent Timing Annex
m06:room.job: Count how many independent pieces of evidence three matching slips are.

m07:room.title: The Impulse Review Room
m07:room.job: Establish what the October brake pulse and the operator card each prove.

m08:room.title: The Period Trace Cabin
m08:room.job: Compare the motor's push rate with the Narwhal's own swing period.

m09:room.title: The Arm Inspection Loft
m09:room.job: Work out the twisting the tested gust puts on arm nine's root pin.

m10:room.title: The Loop Dynamics Office
m10:room.job: Find out whether the drawing's crown radius gives the coaster its margin.

m11:room.title: The Flume Hydraulic Lab
m11:room.job: Work out what the Otter Flume draws from the shared motor plant.

m12:room.title: The Tower Witness Cabin
m12:room.job: Bound what the witnessed drop-tower stop proves.

m13:room.title: The Capacity Schedule Office
m13:room.job: Add the park's rides up for one moment in the day.

m14:room.title: The Geometry Verification Room
m14:room.job: Settle what the real crown radius leaves the coaster.

m15:room.title: The Park Evidence Board
m15:room.job: Settle what one park certificate can honestly carry.
